I'm not sure if it's because Ho Chi Minh City has a higher cost of living, but the restaurants here offer worse value for money than the ones we visited in Hanoi, Hue, and Da Nang. There's also an additional 8% tax that we weren't aware of in advance — we didn't see any notice mentioning that tax would be charged separately. That said, the food tasted pretty good.

I lost my hat, and they actually ran out after me to return it — much appreciated. Thanks to the server Sumi for the great service.
